notes.title: IHAS 1.3.1 Patch Notes:
notes.notes:
[h3]IHAS v1.3.1 is now live, and it includes the following:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Updated level layout
[*] Removed distortion from the force field
[*] Balancing improvements
[*] Improved level navigation
[*] Moved the button in the hotel table below the tablet in the hall
[*] Made doors in the office easier to see
[*] Improved tutorial that player can use a knife to press buttons
[*] Fixed that keypad doors are difficult to find in the office
[*] Give players more time to hop onto platforms
[*] Added SFX to barricade
[*] Tweaked a locker to give more resources
[*] Changed the collision of the floor in the puzzle rooms close to the barrier in the servers
[*] Added that you can increase volume of the voices
[*] Made hidden room more visible in hotel
[*] Decreased difficulty for lasers in hotel
[*] Made that you can’t go through the lasers and survive inside ruins
[*] Made that blocked door will not play locked sfx
[*] Moved mod tutorial in the office lower
[*] Moved jump pad in the storage little bit back
[*] Made it so the vent on the second floor in the underwater station doesn't get stuck
[*] Made it so the shotgun + cube puzzle can’t be broken in the bunker
[*] Removed unused doors in the reactor
[*] Added a tutorial for destroying mines
[*] Fixed some message localization issues
[*] Added landmarks to the levels
[*] Fixed that sometimes doors can close in front of the player
[*] Improved grenade tutorial
[*] Improved player message reading
[*] Added rewards for exploration in the hotel
[*] Fixed proximity on portal triggers
[*] Added healing station to the other side in the underwater station
[*] Fixed that Phoenix key visible after installing in the last level
[*] Level Editor v1.0
[/list]
[u]
Demo v1.1[/u]
[list]
[*] Includes improvements from the main game
[*] Enhanced tutorial
[*] Added a cutscene level
[/list]

notes.title: New Year, New Update!
notes.notes:
Happy new year, everyone! I wish you all the best and I hope that this will shape up to be one of the best years of your life.

With 2023 behind us, I see this as a perfect time to release a new update based on your incredibly useful feedback!

Here is the list of updates:
- Added new pickup animations
- Added new loading screens
- Fixed issues with the AI
- Fixed issues with pickups
- Fixed weapon clipping
- Added some Easter eggs
- Updated level layouts
- Bug fixes & much more

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2187730/IHAS/

notes.title: Patch notes: Fixed a game-breaking bug!
notes.notes:
I released a demo build two weeks ago, and since then, a slew of new bugs were discovered thanks to the community! One especially crucial bug regarding saving phoenix keys was detected, but now it's fixed and the demo is now fully playable. Thank you everyone for your feedback, and if you have any suggestions about what the game might be missing, let me know. I'm always looking for feedback that could help shape the game into its best possible form.

[i]Here is a list of updates:[/i]
- Fixed phoenix key saving bug
- Increased attack range of the melee weapon 
- Fixed keycard saving bug
- Added an Achievement
- Minor bug fixes
